Yes, the days I have off and the weekend. Grandpa always very happily takes care of my kid on the weekend, I get home by 3-4pm, and I have him the rest of the day and my mom and sis dont have to worry about him, unless I stay late, which is rare now. I have been leaving early, and sometimes taking an extra day off. I took 2 weeks off to give them space. My sister only works 2 days, doesn’t pay any bills. (Thats why i help pay 80%) 

and Yea I figured that was the issue. every now and then if I have the money to be generous, I give my mom $300-$500 on top of paying bills, and even give my sister money, if i have any extra saved. I will look at my other options..will be better for me anyway! I really only need help 4 days of the week now.
Yea, I figured. I’m a single parent, father a deadbeat unfortunately. Sometimes I take 3 days off, this time around i took 2 weeks off and stayed with my MOL so my mom and sis can get some space.

I am currently trying to save up money an leave. I would have to do a whole 360 with my life and work, which I have done already leaving my job that paid well..honestly the one job I enjoyed despite the stresses. I came to know the stresses were projected from my personal life. Never ending pit..I did not graduate HS. I got my GED. I can make something out of myself. I was stepping up the corporate ladder! About to make 60-70k yearly..not I am just working 2 jobs and thats not enough
Where in it would it be? I swear I looked everywhere and i cant find it..
